entities.summary: Roger Arnold "Deke" Leonard was a Welsh rock musician, best known as a member of the progressive rock band Man, which he joined and left several times, and for fronting his own rock and roll band Iceberg, which he formed and disbanded several times. He was also an author, raconteur and television panelist.
